item.title: An ultrasound test may more reliably detect ovarian cancer in premenopausal women than the Risk of Malignancy Index
item.description: 1. This cohort study found that the IOTA ADNEX ultrasound model at a 10% risk threshold detected more ovarian cancers in premenopausal women than the currently used Risk of Malignancy Index, making it a better test for triaging patients in secondary care. item.title: Oral nonstatin medication significantly lowers cholesterol in high-risk patients
item.description: 1. Enlicitide also lowered non-high-density lipoprotein cholesterol, apolipoprotein B, and lipoprotein(a) levels without notable safety differences between groups.
